lines.en: I am tall and heavy; I walk slowly.
My shoulders stand above the door.
My flesh sways with every step.
No rush; time belongs to me.
Whatever I step on collapses.
My legs are two pillars.
The rotten parts drag on the ground.
I shift slowly in your direction.
I need not run; you will wait.
My stench arrives before I do.
Flies gather where I pass.
I am too tall to see my feet.
The ground sinks under me.
One of my steps covers three of yours.
I wheeze my way forward.
I am taller than anything you have seen.
I stand here and slowly rot.
Something crawls on my back.
I stay still; my stench does not.
My breath sounds like a leak.
A creature like me can wait.
My skin is sloughing off.
I raise a hand, very slowly.
This body is rotting away.
Flies rest on my shoulder.
I am listening to your heartbeat.
This corner is too small for me.
I lower my head to see you.
You are so small at my feet.
My rotting face is turned to you.
You smell fresh.
I do not blink; my lids are too thick.
You step back; I need not move.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛有一只不行了
lines.en: One of my eyes no longer works.
I look at you the way I look at meat.
Your bones are too thin.
I have your position.
You cut off a piece of rotten flesh.
No pain; I only shed bits.
I slowed, but still walk.
That made me rot faster.
The smell is on your hands now.
My skin split; darker inside.
I swayed.
I am not angry; I am only hungry.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉掉了一块，不疼。
lines.en: A piece of rotten flesh fell off; no pain.
That must have tired you.
Meat. It has been a long time.
That little bit will not fill a tooth.
You stand too near the food.
I will take both of them.
Feed me and I will slow.
My hand is slow; do not dodge.
Rotten food is still food.
Hunger is normal for me.

lines.zh: 这个味道让我想起活着
lines.en: This smell reminds me of being alive.
You will regret holding it up.
I am tall; you hit my knee.
I hardly felt it.
You fell back three steps.
My flesh is soft, but heavy.
The bump stirred up a stench.
Are you still steady on your feet?
I move slowly; do not hurry.
Go around; do not brush past.
My skin stuck to you.
A creature like me has no such luck.
Rotten flesh is no fit company for love.
I only want a cool, dark place.
That question unsettles me.
I disgust even myself.
I forgot such things long ago.
Do not come close; the smell will cling.
I need only quiet.
You are pitying me, are you not?
Just go; leave me be.
Bending down costs me.
It looks pitiful in my hand.
You dropped it; here it is.
My nails are black.
I hold it up; I cannot see it well.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西我不常捡
lines.en: I rarely pick things up from the ground.
It has picked up my smell.
Take it; do not mind the look.
You, standing there.
I come slowly, but I arrive.
Living flesh; long since seen.
I will not run; neither should you.
You have been seen.

lines.zh: 这条路很长，但我有力气
lines.en: The path is long, but I have strength.
You are within my reach.
My belly is very empty.
Your warmth stands out.
I choose you; no exchanges.
Do not shut the door; I can get in.
I shuffle on and do not wait.
You run fast, but you must stop.
I do not detour; I push through.
My footsteps are heavy.
You are ahead; I can smell you.
You locked the door; I will break it.
I am behind you, taking my time.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸我听得很清楚
lines.en: I hear your breathing clearly.
One of my strides is three of yours.
The more you hide, the stronger the smell.
My patience is long.
You have to sleep eventually.
My hand rises, slowly.
This one lands beside you.
My fist is heavy.
You stagger from the push.
I missed; again.

lines.zh: 这一下带着腐肉的味道
lines.en: This blow comes with the smell of rot.
You blocked it; your arm is shaking.
I need no speed, only one hit.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划开了你的袖子
lines.en: My nail tore your sleeve.
You back away; I follow slowly.
The ground gave way first.
I stood up, taller than a tree.
This place used to be clean.
My stench spread before I did.
I was dug out of the earth.

lines.zh: 你听见土裂开的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the earth crack?
The flies came with me.
I stand, and the roof is too low.

lines.zh: 腐烂的东西也会站起来
lines.en: Even rotten things can rise.
I am here, slowly.

lines.zh: 火让我这样的东西最难受
lines.en: Fire is worst for things like me.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，烂肉散了一地
lines.en: I fell and rotten flesh scattered.
Water soaks my rotting flesh.
The blast split me in two.
The arrow sank shallow into rot.

lines.zh: 法术让我的身体烧起来
lines.en: The spell set my body burning.
It seems I am always starving.
Lightning blackened my hide.

lines.zh: 这里连腐肉的味道都没有
lines.en: Not even the smell of rot here.
